note: Declared development sample (G10_TRAINING.md section 4), not an official G9 weighting. It becomes development evidence once inspected. Prompt texts are not stored here: each slot points at a row of a pinned upstream file and holds the sha256 of its text.

selection.pool: RL v1 candidates (local build of 11 Nov: code_contests non-Codeforces after decontam v2; hendrycks MATH train after decontam v2 and the MATH-500 13-gram guard)
selection.rule: lowest sha256(selection_seed:id) per stratum; code 8 aizu/7 atcoder/7 codechef/8 hackerearth; math 5 per level 1-5

A.note: 10-prompt canary, every label: first slot of each code judge and math level, plus the second aizu slot

C.cap: label budget + reply allowance, bounded by the real context
C.note: preregistered subset (first slot of each code judge, first slot of math levels 2 to 5); runs only with --stage C
